name.value: Keefe's Landing Café and General Store

description.value: Keefe's Landing Café and General Store is a combined café and convenience store situated on Uncha Lake Road in BC's remote Central Interior, in the Cariboo-Chilcotin region. Its dual café-and-store format suggests it serves as a rare resupply and rest point for travellers — and potentially touring cyclists — on an otherwise isolated rural road. The lakeside setting and general-store component make it a natural candidate for a cyclist stop in a region with few services.
